title: Trade-offs & the Ship Decision
description: When metrics conflict and a decision is due: weigh competing goods against each other, decide ship or no-ship on a mixed read, and make sure the call isn't resting on a correlation that won't hold.
outcomes: You'll adjudicate a conflicting-metric trade-off, make a defensible ship / no-ship call under a mixed or time-pressured read, and check whether the decision rests on a causal claim or just a correlation.
